Brazil declared a national public health emergency for dengue in February 2024; Q1 2024 is a high-intensity outbreak period — expect elevated case volumes and frequent bulletin updates.
Brazilian federal bulletins are published in Portuguese; ensure extraction pipeline handles Portuguese-language tabular data and terminology.
SINAN microdata may have reporting lag; bulletins published in Q1 2024 may undercount final Q1 totals — note data completeness status when extracting.
State-level (26 states + DF) data granularity is available and should be captured where possible for subnational_location field.
PAHO publishes regional dengue updates that include Brazil-specific data — these serve as strong validation sources against national MS/SVS figures.
Epi week mapping: SE01 2024 = 2024-01-07 to 2024-01-13; SE13 2024 ≈ 2024-03-24 to 2024-03-30 — use this mapping to align date_reported field.
Do not report source_url as discovered; flag for human or automated source retrieval step downstream.
